name: Beniflà (Spain)
description: Blue field with three white wavy stripes along the lower part, charged at the centre with a white scallop shell between two yellow lozenges bearing red bars.
history: The official flag of Beniflà is of proportions 2:3, blue, with a pearl grey scallop at the centre flanked by two yellow lozenges charged with three red bars, and in the lower part three wavy stripes of white or pearl grey alternating with two wavy stripes of blue; it was approved by resolution of 18 January 2016 of the Presidency of the Generalitat and published in the DOCV. The arms had been approved by resolution of 26 March 2012.
